title: Lumen product definition
$comment: product.schema.json — validation design per docs/07-config-driven-system.md §3.2–§3.3. Data-driven constraints (type, required, additionalProperties, enum, const, minimum, maximum, minLength, maxLength, minItems, maxItems, pattern, not.enum) are enforced by crates/product-config's structural pass; filesystem and cross-file rules (path existence + magic bytes, injected enums from themes/locales/profiles listings, catalog-key existence, feature-registry intersection F1/F2, cross-field rules) live in the crate's semantic pass (doc 07 §3.4 stage 3). Extensions beyond standard keywords (ignored by other JSON Schema validators per spec): 'x-lumen-unit' (human unit expansion for range diagnostics), 'x-lumen-hint' (rule-specific fix hint, doc 07 §3.5). An empty 'enum' [] marks a value whose enum is injected at validation time from a directory listing (doc 07 §3.2 'defaults' comment) — the structural pass defers it to the semantic pass.

schema_version.$comment: deliberately not a const: the exact value is the cross-field rule 'schema_version == max(migrations.entries[].to), or 1 when there are no entries', enforced by the semantic pass on the resolved config (doc 07 §3.3). A const here would structurally reject schema v2 the moment the first migration exists.

name.$comment: reserved names per doc 07 §3.3(a), clean-room rule MP §1. short_name's reserved-name check is in the semantic pass.

short_name.x-lumen-hint: compact name for taskbar/tray/'opens with' surfaces: 1-12 chars, ASCII letters, digits and hyphens only, no spaces (doc 07 §2.1).

display_version.x-lumen-hint: human-facing semver-shaped version; engine/catalog/protocol versions are reported by system.get-engine-info, not here (doc 07 §2.1).

version_code.x-lumen-hint: monotonic build number for installers/updaters that compare integers (doc 07 §2.1).

description_key.$comment: must exist in the reference catalog — semantic pass (doc 07 §3.3 cross-field).

reverse_dns.x-lumen-hint: reverse-DNS root, all lowercase, from which per-OS identifiers derive (doc 07 §2.1).

app_user_model_id.$comment: must equal reverse_dns + "." + PascalCase(identity.name) — semantic pass (doc 07 §3.3(b)).

msi_upgrade_code.x-lumen-hint: stable GUID: MSI UpgradeCode must stay constant across versions so upgrades replace instead of co-install (doc 07 §2.1).

bundle_id.$comment: must equal reverse_dns + "." + PascalCase(identity.name) — semantic pass (doc 07 §3.3(b)).

appstream_id.$comment: must equal reverse_dns + "." + PascalCase(identity.name) — semantic pass (doc 07 §3.3(b)).

app_id.$comment: must equal reverse_dns + "." + PascalCase(identity.name) — semantic pass (doc 07 §3.3(b)).

title_template.x-lumen-hint: the only defined variables are {product_name} and {media_title}; unknown variables are a validation error (doc 07 §2.2).

title_idle_key.$comment: must exist in the reference catalog — semantic pass (doc 07 §3.3 cross-field).

accent_color.x-lumen-hint: hex RGB with leading '#', lowercase, e.g. #4f8cff; must equal theme token color.accent.primary once token extraction lands (doc 07 §2.3).

theme.$comment: enum injected at validation time from the themes/ directory listing (doc 07 §3.2, §3.3).

locale.$comment: enum injected at validation time from the locales/ directory listing (doc 07 §3.2, §3.3).

profile.$comment: enum injected at validation time from the profiles/ directory listing (doc 07 §3.2, §3.3).

features.$comment: unknown feature ids are rejected in the semantic pass against the engine feature registry (rule F1, doc 07 §2.7/§3.3); a static enum here would drift.

hw_decode_policy.$comment: grown post-ADR-001 (accepted 2026-10-19, docs/adr/ADR-001-hardware-decode.md): hw-first H.264/HEVC via OS decoders is the accepted policy. The shipped product.toml stays software-only until the Phase 7 audited per-OS integration lands (rule F2 keeps features.hw-decode = false until then).

probe_max_bytes.$comment: 16 MiB floor per the doc 07 §3.5 error contract and the x-lumen-hint rationale; the §2.9 inline comment ('1 MiB..=64 MiB') is the outlier.
probe_max_bytes.x-lumen-hint: probing below 16 MiB rejects valid multi-track files; if you need a lower bound for an embedded target, change the schema range via review (docs/07-config-driven-system.md §3.3), not this value.

enabled.$comment: shipped default false — hard rule (MP §5, MP §12). enabled = true requires urls.privacy (semantic pass).

urls.$comment: all optional at the structural level; telemetry.enabled = true requires urls.privacy (semantic pass, doc 07 §3.3 cross-field).

entries.$comment: entries must satisfy from < to, strictly ascending, no gaps, no duplicate targets, and schema_version == max(to) — semantic pass (doc 07 §3.3 cross-field).

msgid.x-lumen-hint: a localization message key: dot-separated lowercase segments, at least two (doc 07 §3.2 $defs.msgid).

bcp47.x-lumen-hint: a BCP-47 language tag: 2-3 lowercase letters, then optional -Subtag groups (doc 07 §3.2 $defs.bcp47).

repo_path.x-lumen-hint: repo-relative POSIX path: not absolute, no '..' components, no backslashes (doc 07 §2.3, §3.2).
repo_path.$comment: existence and magic bytes are checked in the validator's semantic pass (doc 07 §3.3 path existence).
